caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wrought iron balcony railing set against the backdrop of a building facade. The railing features a repeated pattern of vertical sections divided by pointed arches, each arch decorated with intricate, symmetrical designs of floral and leaf motifs. Across the top of the railing runs a continuous band of intertwined vines and leaves. The background shows the outline of a building wall with rectangular windows, some of which have shutters drawn partially open. The artwork is monochromatic, executed in black ink lines on an off-white or beige paper, and shows both the architectural details of the ironwork and the structure behind it with precise line work and no shading or color variations.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
